title: Air Fryer Crispy Chicken Breast Nuggets
description: These air fryer crispy chicken breast nuggets deliver 35 grams of protein per serving and are ready in 25 minutes. Made with bite-sized lean chicken breast and a light cornflake crunch, they offer a healthier alternative to fast-food favorites. Save it for your next meal prep.
steps: Set up a three-bowl breading station: place the all-purpose flour in the first bowl, the beaten eggs in the second bowl, and the crushed cornflakes mixed with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper in the third bowl.
Working in batches, dredge each chicken piece in the flour, shaking off any excess. Dip the floured chicken into the beaten eggs, letting any extra drip off.
Press the chicken firmly into the spiced cornflake crumbs until fully coated on all sides, then set aside on a clean plate.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 3 minutes. Lightly mist the air fryer basket with olive oil spray.
Arrange the coated chicken nuggets in a single layer in the air fryer basket without overcrowding, and mist the tops lightly with olive oil spray.

Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 10 to 12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through at the 6-minute mark, until the coating is golden brown and the internal temperature of the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
tips: Crush the cornflakes inside a sealed ziplock bag using a rolling pin for an even, fine texture.
Do not overcrowd the air fryer basket; cook the nuggets in two batches if necessary to ensure maximum crispiness.
Leftover cooked nuggets can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and reheated in the air fryer at 350°F (175°C) for 4 minutes.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

video_script.hook: Make these crispy chicken nuggets with 35 grams of protein!
steps_short: Dredge lean chicken breast pieces in flour, beaten eggs, and seasoned cornflakes.
Place the coated nuggets in a single layer in the preheated air fryer basket.
Mist the nuggets lightly with olive oil spray for extra crunch.
Air fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 12 minutes until fully cooked.

issues: Salt quantity is insufficient for 1 1/2 lbs of chicken breast. Standard ratio for poultry is about 1 tsp to 1 1/4 tsp of salt per pound, so 1/2 tsp for 1.5 lbs will taste extremely bland.

Cornflake crumb quantity (1.5 cups / 60g) is typically insufficient to properly coat 1.5 lbs (680g) of chicken breast pieces through a standard 3-step dredging process. Standard amount is around 2.5 to 3 cups.
